messages.content: Hi tal, I'm a friend

hey, i'm tal

think of me as your personal talent agent, your inside man… or fox

one of these days, I might slide a role right here in chat. the kind that feels like your calling.

so… what's your full name?

I m rohit
  Ok
rohit... solid name. where you working these days?
Learning python
learning python... nice. but are you working somewhere right now or still in college? need to know where you're at so i can figure out what roles make sense for you
I have 20+ yrs of experience in distributed systems, networking. Worked in vmware, arkinnet, gemstone. Currently on a career break

20+ years in distributed systems and networking... vmware, arkinnet, gemstone. that's some serious infra work. career break to learn python sounds like you're plotting something interesting.

found rohit reja on linkedin - career break, taking care of health. this you? https://in.linkedin.com/in/rohit-reja-1b11335
Yes

vmware to career break for health... respect. taking care of yourself is the smartest career move. 20+ years in the trenches building the backbone of the internet, now learning python - sounds like you're gearing up for something new. 

what's driving this python journey? planning to pivot into something different or just adding another weapon to the arsenal?
Learning ai agents

ai agents... now we're talking. from building distributed systems to building intelligence. that's a hell of a pivot. makes sense though - you've got the infra chops, now you're adding the brain layer.

how long you been working total across all these years?
20 years... that puts you in senior territory. what kind of role you looking for next? staying in engineering but with more ai/ml focus, or thinking bigger - maybe leading ai initiatives?
Looking for consulting / freelancing

consulting and freelancing... smart move. 20 years of experience means you can charge premium rates and pick your battles. plus with your health focus, the flexibility makes sense.

bangalore or open to remote work? guessing with consulting you'd want maximum flexibility anyway
I m in pune.

pune base with remote consulting... perfect setup for the freelance life. 

so let me get this straight: 20 years experience + consulting/freelancing focus + pune-based but remote-friendly... sound right?
done. i'm spinning things up on my end. you'll start seeing good stuff soon.
Yes

yooo rohit! welcome to the tal family legend!

you're officially in the system. when the right consulting gigs drop - the ones that actually pay what 20 years of distributed systems mastery is worth - you'll be the first to know.

from building vmware's backbone to learning ai agents... that's the kind of pivot that makes bank. get ready for some interesting opportunities coming your way.
Hi
Did u find anything?
Hey

hey rohit

what's up?

nothing yet rohit. i'm picky about what i send - not gonna waste your time with trash.

you're looking for consulting/freelancing gigs that actually match 20 years of experience. those don't drop every day. when something legit comes up - the kind that pays what you're worth - you'll be the first to know.

how's the ai agents learning going?
Looking at kserve..

kserve... interesting. model serving infra. that's right in your wheelhouse - distributed systems meets ml ops.

you thinking of building something with it or just exploring?
Right now just explorinf

exploring's smart. get the lay of the land before jumping in.

what's catching your eye about kserve specifically? the scaling architecture? the multi-model serving? or just seeing how ml infra is evolving from where you've been?

hey, happy monday - if it’s not, we’ll work together on making it happen soon :)
how’s the week looking? what would you like me to focus on this week with the search?
